description: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM 7.x) CLI — storage health, backup tasks, Docker containers, scheduled tasks, and file management via the Synology Web API

auth_env_var_specs.name: SYNOLOGY_DSM_SIDCOOKIE
auth_env_var_specs.description: Synology DSM session ID (SID) obtained via webapi login

novel_features.name: NAS Health Summary
novel_features.description: Aggregates backup task status, disk SMART health, and storage volume usage into a single ok/warn/error summary

novel_features.name: Storage Statistics
novel_features.description: Aggregated storage capacity across volumes and pools with total, used, free, and usage percentage

novel_features.name: Utilization Breakdown
novel_features.description: Per-resource utilization with severity levels (ok/warn/critical) and configurable thresholds

novel_features.name: Storage Trends
novel_features.description: Storage capacity trends from archived sync snapshots with growth rates and estimated time-to-capacity

novel_features.name: Full-text Search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search across all synced NAS resources in the local SQLite store

novel_features.name: Offline Export
novel_features.description: Export synced NAS resources to stdout in JSON or CSV format for scripting and analysis
